inspiration.observed_pattern: A FULLTEXT-indexed column feeds a MATCH ... AGAINST predicate in a filtered query.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced from match_against_boolean_search to two independently authored cards: one required-token match and one excluded-token rejection, retaining the FULLTEXT index and BOOLEAN MODE predicate while removing the third non-matching row and final table-state check.

fixture_notes: Card 201 matches the required token; card 202 is rejected because it also contains the excluded token.
determinism_notes: Card IDs, text, search operators, and ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE knowledge_cards_min (card_id INT PRIMARY KEY, body TEXT NOT NULL, FULLTEXT KEY ft_knowledge_body_min (body))
INSERT INTO knowledge_cards_min VALUES (201, 'Distributed caches reduce latency'), (202, 'Distributed queues use a legacy relay')

steps.sql: SELECT card_id FROM knowledge_cards_min WHERE MATCH(body) AGAINST ('+distributed -legacy' IN BOOLEAN MODE) ORDER BY card_id

checks.sql: SELECT card_id, body FROM knowledge_cards_min ORDER BY card_id
